name: About
description: Opens the About Aseprite window

name: AddColor
description: Adds a new color to the palette.

name: AdvancedMode
description: Toggles the application's "Advanced Mode"

name: BackgroundFromLayer
description: Equivalent to using Convert To -> Background in the Layer's context menu

name: Cancel
description: Equivalent to pressing the Esc key

name: CelOpacity
description: Changes the opacity of the active Cel

name: CelProperties
description: Shows the Properties dialog for the active Cel

name: ChangeBrush
description: Changes the brush of the active tool

name: ChangeColor
description: Changes the current foreground or background color

name: Clear
description: Clear the current active document

name: ClearCel
description: Clear the active cel in unlocked layers

name: ClearRecentFiles
description: Clear the recent files list

name: CloseAllFiles
description: Close all open files

name: CloseFile
description: Close the active file

name: ColorQuantization
description: Creates a palette from the current sprite

name: ContiguousFill
description: Changes the current tool to Contiguous Fill

name: ConvolutionMatrix
description: Select and apply a convolution matrix to the image

name: Copy
description: Performs a copy command on the current selection

name: CopyMerged
description: Copies the active sprite as a merged image to the clipboard

name: Cut
description: Performs a cut command on the current selection

name: DeselectMask
description: Deselects the current mask

name: Despeckle
description: Applies median blur

name: DiscardBrush
description: Discard the active brush

name: DuplicateLayer
description: Duplicate the currently selected layer

name: DuplicateView
description: Duplicates the current workspace view

name: Exit
description: Instructs Aseprite to exit, the user will be prompted to save if any files are modified and it can be canceled

name: Eyedropper
description: Grabs the color under the current mouse position with the Eyedropper tool

name: Fill
description: Performs a foreground color fill on the current selection mask

name: FitScreen
description: Resets the zoom on the current view to fit the screen

name: FullscreenPreview
description: Opens the full screen preview

name: GridSettings
description: Opens the grid settings window

name: Home
description: Opens the Home tab

name: InvertMask
description: Inverts the current selection mask, or if there is none, selects all

name: KeyboardShortcuts
description: Opens the keyboard shortcut menu, use the `search` parameter to pre-fill the searchbar

name: Launch
description: Opens the given `path` in the desktop web browser as relative path to aseprite.org or a full URL

name: LayerFromBackground
description: Converts the active background layer to a regular layer

name: LayerLock
description: Toggles the lock of active layers

name: LayerProperties
description: Opens the Layer property window for the active layer

name: LayerVisibility
description: Toggles the visibility of the active layer

name: LinkCels
description: Links the selected cels together

name: LoadMask
description: Loads a selection from file

name: LoadPalette
description: Loads a palette from file

name: MaskAll
description: Selects all

name: MaskByColor
description: Creates a new selection by color

name: MaskContent
description: Selects the content from the active sprite (like autocrop)

name: MergeDownLayer
description: Merges the active layer down

name: MoveCel
description: Finishes the move operation of a cel in the timeline

name: MoveMask
description: Moves the selection boundaries or its content (pixels).

name: NewBrush
description: Create a new brush from the current selection/editor

name: NewFrameTag
description: Shows the New Tag dialog for the selected frame range

name: NewSpriteFromSelection
description: Creates a new sprite from the current selection mask

name: OpenBrowser
description: Open the given `filename` in the internal text browser

name: OpenGroup
description: Opens the active layer group

name: OpenInFolder
description: Opens the folder of the active sprite in the file explorer

name: OpenWithApp
description: Opens the active sprite with the native app assigned to the format

name: PaletteEditor
description: Show the palette editor popup

name: PaletteSize
description: Changes the palette size

name: Paste
description: Pastes the clipboard into the current active sprite/selection, at coordinates `x` and `y` (if given)

name: PasteText
description: Opens the Insert Text dialog

name: PixelPerfectMode
description: Toggles the "pixel perfect" freehand algorithm

name: PlayAnimation
description: Plays the sprite's animation, if any

name: PlayPreviewAnimation
description: Plays the animation in the preview window (enables it if it's not visible)

name: Redo
description: Equivalent to `app.redo()`

name: Refresh
description: Refreshes the user interface

name: RemoveFrame
description: Remove the selected or the current active frame(s) (only if there's more 1 frame total)

name: RemoveFrameTag
description: Remove a tag by the given `name` or object `id`

name: RemoveLayer
description: Remove the selected or current active layer(s) (only if there's more than 1 layer total)

name: RemoveSlice
description: Remove a slice by `name` or object `id`

name: RepeatLastExport
description: Redoes the last export command

name: ReselectMask
description: Re-selects a hidden selection mask

name: ReverseFrames
description: Reverses frames (only if there are 2 or more in the selected range)

name: ScrollCenter
description: Center the editor viewport

name: SelectTile
description: Select the tile under the mouse, with a selection `mode` ([SelectionMode](selectionmode.md))

name: SelectionAsGrid
description: Set the grid bounds to the current selection mask

name: SetColorSelector
description: Changes the color selector to the `type`: `"spectrum"`, `"tint-shade-tone"`, `"rgb-wheel"`, `"ryb-wheel"` or `"normal-map-wheel"`

name: SetLoopSection
description: Sets the looping property of the given frame range

name: SetPaletteEntrySize
description: Set the palette entry size to the given `size` (defaults to `7`)

name: SetSameInk
description: Set the same ink for all tools

name: ShowAutoGuides
description: Toggles the "Show Auto Guides" preference

name: ShowBrushPreview
description: Toggles the "Brush Preview" preference

name: ShowExtras
description: Toggles the "Show Extras" preference

name: ShowGrid
description: Toggles the "Show Grid" preference

name: ShowLayerEdges
description: Toggles the "Show Layer Edges" preference

name: ShowOnionSkin
description: Toggles the "Onion Skin" preference

name: ShowPixelGrid
description: Toggles the "Show Pixel Grid"  preference

name: ShowSelectionEdges
description: Toggles the "Show Selection Edges" preference

name: ShowSlices
description: Toggles the "Show Slices" preference

name: SliceProperties
description: Shows the slice properties window by `name` or `id` parameters, otherwise uses the selected slice(s)

name: SnapToGrid
description: Toggles the snap to grid property

name: SpriteProperties
description: Shows the sprite properties window

name: Stroke
description: Performs a foreground color stroke fill on the current selection mask

name: SwitchColors
description: Swaps the current foreground/background colors around

name: SymmetryMode
description: Sets the symmetry mode `orientation` to one of `"vertical"`, `"horizontal"`, `"right_diagonal"` or `"left_diagonal"`. Defaults to none, which turns the mode off

name: TiledMode
description: Sets the tiled to mode `axis` to one of `"both"`, `"x"` or `"y"`. Defaults to none, which turns the mode off

name: Timeline
description: Changes the timeline visibility with the parameters `open`, `close` and `switch`

name: TogglePreview
description: Toggles the visibility of the preview window

name: ToggleTimelineThumbnails
description: Toggles the timeline thumbnails preference

name: ToggleWorkspaceLayout
description: Toggles the Workspace Layout UI. This command only opens or closes the workspace layout mode, and cannot be used to select a specific Layout.

name: UndoHistory
description: Shows the undo history window

name: UnlinkCel
description: Equivalent to `app.undo()`

name: Zoom
description: Changes the zoom on the active editor

name: DeveloperConsole
description: Opens the developer console (experimental)

name: OpenScriptFolder
description: Opens the Aseprite script folder in the file explorer

name: RunScript
description: Run a script given by the `filename` parameter - any other parameters are passed to the script.
